items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: me. Big Greene was sitting up there. He scared me to death.

ctx.x: And so I don't go and make the matinee. So they can't start playing nothing. So they got somebody to come up there and get me. Oh, I'm telling you. And I rushed myself and got on down there. And when I did get there and got on the bandstand, I said -- and then Big Green was behind
me. Big Greene was sitting up there. He scared me to death. He said, "I'm going to kill you when you get off there." "When you get off this bandstand, you little so and so, I'm going to kill you."
